WITH tenant_column_upper_bound AS ( SELECT resource_column.id AS resource_column_id, max(CASE template_item.access_mode WHEN 'VISIBLE' THEN 3 WHEN 'MASKED' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END) AS access_rank FROM iam_tenant_column_permission_template_assignment assignment JOIN iam_column_permission_template template ON template.id = assignment.template_id AND template.deleted_at IS NULL AND template.is_enabled = true JOIN iam_column_permission_template_item template_item ON template_item.template_id = template.id AND template_item.deleted_at IS NULL JOIN iam_resource_column resource_column ON resource_column.id = template_item.resource_column_id AND resource_column.deleted_at IS NULL AND resource_column.is_enabled = true WHERE assignment.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND assignment.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY resource_column.id ), role_column_rule AS ( SELECT resource_column.id AS resource_column_id, max(CASE rule.access_mode WHEN 'VISIBLE' THEN 3 WHEN 'MASKED' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END) AS access_rank FROM iam_role_column_permission_rule rule JOIN iam_resource_column resource_column ON resource_column.id = rule.resource_column_id AND resource_column.deleted_at IS NULL AND resource_column.is_enabled = true WHERE rule.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND rule.deleted_at IS NULL
AND rule.role_id IN
#{roleId}
AND 1 = 0
GROUP BY resource_column.id ) SELECT resource_column.resource_key AS resourceKey, resource_column.column_key AS columnKey, CASE LEAST( coalesce(tenant_column_upper_bound.access_rank, 1), coalesce(role_column_rule.access_rank, tenant_column_upper_bound.access_rank, 1) ) WHEN 3 THEN 'VISIBLE' WHEN 2 THEN 'MASKED' ELSE 'HIDDEN' END AS accessMode FROM iam_resource_column resource_column LEFT JOIN tenant_column_upper_bound ON tenant_column_upper_bound.resource_column_id = resource_column.id LEFT JOIN role_column_rule ON role_column_rule.resource_column_id = resource_column.id WHERE resource_column.deleted_at IS NULL AND resource_column.is_enabled = true ORDER BY resource_column.resource_key, resource_column.sort_no, resource_column.column_key
